text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll check back in with you about the mock race in two days.
Thank you for your time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after making that promise with Eishin Flash.
In order to give her the "experience" she sought...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stood facing the Tracen Academy Student Council President
and "Triple Crown Umamusume," Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, but could you say that one more time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What is it that you came to ask of me—
of the 'Emperor,' Symboli Rudolf?"
choice_data_list: I want you to run with Eishin Flash

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So I didn't mishear you after all.
No, it's just a rather unexpected offer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: There are Umamusume who want to race against me, but no Trainer wants to let their Umamusume race me.
choice_data_list: Few Umamusume can withstand the pressure of competing against the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Are you saying she's one of the few who aren't?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? Let's hear the details.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash's proposal of stacking up mock races isn't bad, but in the end, it's still just "practice."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yet if you run against a Derby winner, you can truly feel what she possesses. Only what you experience firsthand can truly be called 'knowledge.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see.
So you intend to have me do the work of a thousand soldiers.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"So you're trying to steal my 'Derby-winning experience.'
You're quite the audacious Trainer, aren't you?"
choice_data_list: Because it's what we need to win the Derby

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
I understand your dedication to the Umamusume you train."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And there's one more thing I noticed.
Eishin Flash—
for some reason, she seems rather impatient, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is it due to her strict, upright nature, or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have a proposal for you.
I wouldn't mind being your running partner, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The "experience" she needs might just be painted in far more vivid colors.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Like the lush green turf, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, as instructed by Symboli Rudolf,
I headed to the racetrack after the graded stakes race—

Haaah, today's race was awesome too!
It was the ultimate freedom... It's making me itch to run.

Footsteps, heavy breathing, cheers...
Everything I want to feel is right here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"To call you 'just a race-loving Umamusume'...
would be a stretch, given how recognizable you are."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That Umamusume claimed the long-unclaimed
"Triple Crown Umamusume" title through an electrifying run that captivated the masses.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'm Mr. C.B.
Isn't that enough?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The legendary Umamusume standing alongside Symboli Rudolf, Mr. C.B.
She was—the "experience" shown to her.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's your turn next, Mister Trainer.
I hope it's a fun story?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's your turn next, Miss Trainer.
I hope it's a fun story?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—A tandem run?
Sure thing~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Getting to race against someone running in the Derby sounds like a blast, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, as long as it lets me have a 'fun' run,
I'll take you on anytime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then came the morning of my promise with Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll go get ready.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. We'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting the chance to test herself against a great senior, Eishin Flash is also fired up.
Her ability not to let the pressure get to her is one of her greatest strengths.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm still not fully convinced.
'Run a race that lets you feel what the Derby truly means'...
Why is that supposed to lead to experience?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Still, running against a Triple Crown Umamusume will be great experience before the Derby."
choice_data_list: Go out there and run without fear!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so a mock race between just the two of them began—with the victor decided in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...300m to go. C.B.-san is
still on the corner... I can win this――!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm...
—Is it about time?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looked like Mr. C.B. mumbled something. And in the next instant—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Yup, I win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B., who was far behind Eishin Flash, unleashed an unbelievable late charge and crossed the finish line first.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Flash.
Do you like running?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me,
I don't quite understand the point of your question."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It means exactly what it sounds like.
Do you like running?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Running does not rely on emotion.
I run because it is what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Then what about the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I heard you want to become a Derby Umamusume,
but you don't feel anything special toward the Derby itself?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...
That's...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You thought you could win today's race, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can tell. It'd be weird if I couldn't.
Because that's just how focused I am on everything.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The secret to winning the Derby, you see...
is believing that you will win.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fuel the engine with my sheer obsession to win!
I'll swallow up the cheers, my rivals, my limits, and even luck itself!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't care if I leave everything right here—
I'm gonna run, run, and run with every ounce of my being.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Because you only get one shot at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Well, did you get it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me, but I don't understand.
That expression is intuitive, vague, and entirely unpractical.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're so honest.
Well, think about it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What happens after this run... is up to you, I suppose.
In this once-in-a-lifetime race,
what will you feel, and what will you grasp—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I'm not sure.
Though in practical terms, I gained a great deal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yet aside from that... I have this strange feeling.
Ever since CB passed me... I've felt it all this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She doesn't seem able to put it into words, but perhaps she's grasped that 'something' she truly needs.
choice_data_list: Try to remember that feeling at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to run alongside a Triple Crown Umamusume...
I never could have come up with an idea like this myself."
choice_data_list: That's why I'm here for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That's true. Someone who can give me a fresh perspective for the sake of my growth...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I truly appreciate everything you
and CB-san have done for me."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I must show everyone flawless results
at the Japan Derby to repay their support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no impatience in her words.
It seemed she had grown once more in preparation for the Japanese Derby.
